current_difficulty_reason: Equidistribution of Galois orbits applies only after the multiplier-isospectral moduli point has been descended to a number field. The source constructs periodic cycles shadowing a chosen repeller while tracking their periods and characteristic exponents, rather than merely quoting the needed periodic approximation. It then combines those cycles with the arithmetic orbit bounds and exponent rigidity to obtain the exceptional classification, leaving a new dynamical construction beyond the cited equidistribution and rigidity foundations.
